meta.name: internal-comms
meta.description: A set of resources to help me write all kinds of internal communications, using the formats that my company likes to use. Claude should use this skill whenever asked to write some sort of internal communications (status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按公司模板撰写各类内部通知与报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要频繁撰写公司内部沟通文档。
copy.tagline_en: Write internal communications using company-approved formats.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently write internal company communications.

howto.what: Claude 会按你公司喜欢的格式来写内部沟通稿：3P 更新、公司简报、FAQ、状态报告等。它先判断沟通类型，再从 examples/ 目录加载对应的指南文件，照着里面的格式、语气和内容要求来写。
howto.when: 当你要求写内部沟通类内容时触发，比如状态报告、领导层更新、3P 更新等。若类型不匹配任何现有指南文件，它会先向你询问格式或补充更多背景。

say.text: 帮我写一份这周的 3P 更新
写一篇公司简报，主题是季度进展
把这次故障写成一份事故报告
say.note: 类型不匹配时它会先问格式

howto.what_en: Claude writes internal communications in your company's formats: 3P updates, newsletters, FAQs, status reports and more. It identifies the type, loads the matching guideline file from examples/, and follows its formatting and tone.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for an internal communication, such as a status report, leadership update or 3P update. If the type matches no guideline file, it asks for the format or more context.

say_en.text: Draft a company newsletter about the quarter
Write an incident report for this outage
say_en.note: Asks for format if no guideline matches
